verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent-behavior settings say agents present a structured plan of each implementation step, which gives a lead a scope review before implementation. The docs do not state that repository changes are blocked until someone approves that plan. The PR-creation permission toggle and the resume-paused-run API are related controls, not scope approval, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit approval gate before repo modification, a contract/spec sign-off workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can approve a task's scope and contract before an agent is allowed to modify the repository

citations.quote: Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
